label: NEGATIVE RESULT
rationale: Auch Action-Level-Control (Schema-7) erzeugt keinen robusten Gameplay-Vorteil. D-24 (representative trained schema-7) is byte-identical to rule on seed 001 and loses 26867 land on seed 002 (model-caused, 201 divergent turns). It does not beat the rule/run3 champion bar on dev.
nextBottleneck: Training signal / model quality: the model imitates the rule’s dispatch order (9/10 trained variants byte-identical), so it only overrides where its own signal is strong — and that signal is still anchored to ruleUtility (D-24 flipToLowerRate=0.15, flipToHigherRate=0). The next reproducible bottleneck is the training objective (rank loss anchored to rule utility), not the action-level control architecture.
